speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Atypical melanocytes that infiltrate the epidermis and dermis, confirming the diagnosis of malignant melanoma. The lesion exhibits asymmetry, border irregularity, and varied color with a diameter larger than 6mm. It is firm on palpation, partly elevated, and does not change form on pinching.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malignant Melanoma. Given the biopsy confirmation showing atypical melanocytes and classic ABCD criteria (asymmetry, border irregularity, color variation, diameter >6mm), I recommend immediate wide local excision and referral to a surgical oncologist for staging.
